title: TrialAgentBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Clinical-Trial Analysis and Long-Horizon Drug-Development Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2611.30916v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical drug development is a long-horizon, high-stakes process requiring sequential decisions based on information that costs money and time to acquire. AI agents have demonstrated capabilities for scientific analysis, but there is no established way to evaluate them on these decisions, as real trials are expensive, involve people, and never reveal the counterfactual. We introduce TrialAgentBench, a benchmark for evaluating AI agents on clinical trial analysis and drug development decision-making using simulated trials where the truth is known, embedded within the data records of a fictional drug sponsor. We publicly release nearly 3,500 tasks, varying from analysing a single trial to managing multi-phase programmes with budget and time constraints. translated_title: TrialAgentBench：评估AI智能体在临床试验分析与长期药物开发决策中的能力
translated_abstract: 临床药物开发是一个周期长、风险高的过程，需要基于花费金钱和时间才能获取的信息做出一系列连续决策。AI智能体已展现出科学分析的能力，但目前尚无成熟的方法来评估它们在这类决策上的表现，因为真实试验成本高昂、涉及真人参与，且永远不会揭示反事实结果。我们提出了TrialAgentBench，这是一个用于评估AI智能体在临床试验分析和药物开发决策方面能力的基准测试，它使用真相已知的模拟试验，并将这些试验嵌入一家虚构药物赞助商的数据记录之中。我们公开发布了近3500个任务，涵盖从分析单个试验到在预算和时间约束下管理多阶段药物开发项目。我们通过在新试验上重新运行分析代码来为每项分析评分，并根据决策所实现的价值为每个开发项目评分。在24个闭源和开源权重模型中，最强的智能体能够分……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 提出了TrialAgentBench基准，利用真相已知的模拟试验发布近3500个任务，首次系统评估AI智能体在临床试验分析和预算时间约束下的长期药物开发决策能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces TrialAgentBench, a benchmark with nearly 3,500 tasks based on simulated trials with known ground truth, enabling systematic evaluation of AI agents on clinical-trial analysis and long-horizon drug-development decision-making.
